description: This is a team of 5 people who decided to make a VR simulation of a Space Experience. Its made in Unity. We are a team interested in making games and having fun.
summary: we made and immersive experience in VR creating a space staion space walk
details: We have created a VR experience for young people to get a taste of what it's like to be an astronaut. It is very immersive while staying fun and engaging for children. We hope that we can help kids across the world to become aspiring astronauts. We used Unity to develop our project, and our models were designed in SolidWorks and coloured in Blender. We have balanced realistic zero gravity with fun VR movement to keep people engaged and still learning real things about what it's like in space. We had to consider how quickly children could comprehend the zero gravity and VR aspects, and to avoid excessive cognitive load we used very simple and clear graphics. With more time we could make it more immersive and explore common tasks astronauts must do.
